mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-crisis recovery phases, a stable federal funds rate below 0.5% signals confidence in economic stabilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-crisis recovery periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 218.0, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 218.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases, a housing starts rate above 600 thousand units signals a rebound in consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of early recovery periods with HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
